components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Plain cobalt main action in the dish editor's bottom bar («Создать» / «Сохранить»); dark theme uses cornflower cobalt with navy text. The calculator has none.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:48px; padding:0 14px; min-width:160px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--radius, 0.875rem); background:var(--primary, oklch(0.514 0.192 265)); color:var(--primary-foreground, #fff); font-family:'Rubik Variable', sans-serif; font-weight:500; font-size:0.875rem; transition:all .15s; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary, oklch(0.514 0.192 265)) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { border-color:var(--ring, oklch(0.514 0.192 265)); outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, oklch(0.514 0.192 265)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:.5; pointer-events:none; }

components.css: .ds-shelf { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-family:'Rubik Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; height:36px; margin:4px 0; padding:0 14px; border-radius:9999px; background:var(--secondary, oklch(0.929 0.013 255.5)); color:var(--foreground, oklch(0.267 0.054 269.1)); font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:500; text-decoration:none; white-space:nowrap; transition:background .15s; } .ds-chip:hover { background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--secondary, oklch(0.929 0.013 255.5)), var(--foreground, oklch(0.267 0.054 269.1)) 6%); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, oklch(0.514 0.192 265)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-chip-current, .ds-chip-current:hover { background:var(--card, oklch(1 0 0)); font-weight:600; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--foreground, oklch(0.267 0.054 269.1)); }

components.css: .ds-tiles { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:8px; width:340px; font-family:'Rubik Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-tile { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; gap:2px; padding:10px 16px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:calc(var(--radius, 0.875rem) * 1.4); background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted, oklch(0.944 0.01 252.8)) 60%, transparent); color:var(--foreground, oklch(0.267 0.054 269.1)); text-align:left; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s; } .ds-tile:hover { background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--card, oklch(1 0 0)) 60%, transparent); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, oklch(0.514 0.192 265)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-tile-active, .ds-tile-active:hover { background:var(--card, oklch(1 0 0)); border-color:var(--border, oklch(0.898 0.016 257.2)); } .ds-tile-label { font-size:0.875rem; line-height:1.25; color:var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.526 0.045 262.7)); } .ds-tile-active .ds-tile-label { color:var(--foreground, oklch(0.267 0.054 269.1)); font-weight:500; } .ds-tile-num { display:flex; align-items:baseline; font-size:1.875rem; line-height:1.25; font-weight:500; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-tile-unit { margin-left:4px; font-size:1rem; font-weight:400; color:var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.526 0.045 262.7)); } .ds-caret { display:inline-block; width:3px; height:0.9em; margin-left:2px; align-self:center; border-radius:9999px; background:var(--caret-2, oklch(0.66 0.13 85)); animation:ds-blink 1.06s step-end infinite; } @keyframes ds-blink { 50% { opacity:0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-caret { animation:none; background:var(--primary, oklch(0.514 0.192 265)); } }

components.css: .ds-bar { position:relative; display:flex; width:340px; height:48px; font-family:'Rubik Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-seg { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:0; color:var(--chart-foreground, oklch(0.267 0.054 269.1)); font-size:0.75rem; line-height:1.25; cursor:pointer; } .ds-seg:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, oklch(0.514 0.192 265)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-seg-name { font-weight:500; } .ds-seg-g { font-size:1rem; font-weight:600; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-seg-1 { width:54%; background:var(--chart-1, oklch(0.815 0.073 246.3)); border-radius:calc(var(--radius, 0.875rem) * 1.4) 0 0 calc(var(--radius, 0.875rem) * 1.4); } .ds-seg-2 { width:46%; background:var(--chart-2, oklch(0.871 0.14 91.6)); border-radius:0 calc(var(--radius, 0.875rem) * 1.4) calc(var(--radius, 0.875rem) * 1.4) 0; box-shadow:inset 2px 0 0 var(--background, oklch(0.969 0.006 255.5)); } .ds-seg-sel { font-weight:600; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--foreground, oklch(0.267 0.054 269.1)); } .ds-grip { position:absolute; left:54%; top:50%; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:32px; height:32px; border:1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.898 0.016 257.2)); border-radius:9999px; background:var(--background, oklch(0.969 0.006 255.5)); color:var(--foreground, oklch(0.267 0.054 269.1)); box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18); cursor:grab; transition:transform .15s ease-out; } .ds-grip:active { transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.1); box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.22); }

components.css: .ds-keypad { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); grid-auto-rows:56px; gap:8px; width:340px; font-family:'Rubik Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-key { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:0; border-radius:var(--radius, 0.875rem); background:var(--secondary, oklch(0.929 0.013 255.5)); color:var(--foreground, oklch(0.267 0.054 269.1)); font-size:1.5rem; font-weight:500; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .1s, background .15s; } .ds-key:hover { background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--secondary, oklch(0.929 0.013 255.5)), var(--foreground, oklch(0.267 0.054 269.1)) 6%); } .ds-key:active { transform:scale(0.97); } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, oklch(0.514 0.192 265)) 50%, transparent); } .ds-key-op { background:var(--muted, oklch(0.944 0.01 252.8)); color:var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.526 0.045 262.7)); font-size:1.125rem; } .ds-key-op:hover { background:var(--accent, oklch(0.938 0.018 261.3)); color:var(--foreground, oklch(0.267 0.054 269.1)); } .ds-key-tall { grid-row:span 2; } .ds-key-wide { grid-column:span 2; }

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "Ланчбокс"**

Every eater is a lid color. The calculator reads as lunchboxes laid out on a frosted counter: a cool, slightly blue polypropylene ground, navy ink for every number, one cobalt action, and a row of pastel lids (sky, sunflower, mint, lilac, apricot) that belong to people, not to the interface. The user chose this world out of three proposals («Ланчбокс», «Калькулятор», «Табло»).

The surface is a working tool for a phone at the stove: large tabular numerals, big thumb-reach keys, and almost no decoration. Depth comes from tonal steps (frosted ground, white lidded box, a frost-grey key), not from shadows. Color is quarantined: the lids appear only where a person owns the mark, so a glance at a color is a glance at a name. The tone avoids sterile medical coldness and the default shadcn look without letting anything compete with the grams.

Light and dark follow the phone's setting (next-themes, `defaultTheme="system"`, `.dark` on `<html>`). Dark is "night" polypropylene: navy ground, a lifted navy box, the same lids slightly deepened, and a lighter cornflower cobalt so the main action still reads.
keyCharacteristics: Frosted cool-white ground, navy ink, a single plain cobalt primary.
Five lid colors assigned by a person's place in today's lineup, repeating after five.
Numbers first: tabular Rubik in medium weight, 30 px for readouts and answers.
Flat, tonal layering; the active field is a white lidded box with a 1 px seam, idle tiles sit a frosted step below.
Generous radii (0.875rem base, ~1.2rem on boxes and the share bar).
A blinking caret that cycles through today's lids.

rules.name: The Color Quarantine Rule
rules.body: Lid colors appear only on person-owned marks: share-bar segments, the lid mark beside a name, and the caret. Chrome stays ink and cobalt.

rules.name: The Ring, Not Flood Rule
rules.body: Selection is a ring (`ring-2` in ink, inset), never a fill that would hide the person's color. The current dish chip on the shelf takes the same mark.

rules.name: The Plain Cobalt Rule
rules.body: Primary buttons are a flat cobalt fill with white (or, in dark, navy) text. The user declined decorated primary buttons.

rules.name: The Tabular Grams Rule
rules.body: Every number a person reads or types uses tabular figures (`tabular-nums`, and all `inputmode="decimal"` inputs), so digits don't jump while typing.

rules.name: The Quiet Unit Rule
rules.body: Units and explanations sit one step down in size and in `slate-muted-ink`; the number carries the weight.

rules.name: The Drag-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Only draggable or floating controls cast a shadow; boxes, tiles, chips, and keys are separated by tone.

dos: **Do** give each person their lid by place in today's lineup (`--chart-1..5`), repeating after five, and put navy `--chart-foreground` text on it.
**Do** mark the active field as a white lidded box with a 1 px seam; signal state by shape and border as well as color.
**Do** keep every gram tabular and every gram input ≥ 16 px and ≥ 44 px tall.
**Do** show selection as an inset ring that keeps the person's color visible.
**Do** derive a new caret color by deepening the lid's hue to ≥ 3:1 on white (light) or mixing 30% toward the ink in oklab (dark).
**Do** quote interface text in Russian and follow docs/SPEC.md §2 terminology («вес с тарой» / «вес без тары»).
donts: **Don't** use lid colors on chrome: buttons, headers, tabs, borders, and backgrounds stay ink, frost, and cobalt.
**Don't** decorate the primary button (no gradients, patterns, or lid trims); it stays plain cobalt.
**Don't** flood a selected segment or row with a new fill that hides the person's color.
**Don't** mix theme colors in oklch when the hue matters; mix in oklab.
**Don't** hardcode colors; use the shadcn theme variables.
